signature.name: Bahrain Fort
signature.detail: A UNESCO World Heritage site, this sprawling 16th-century Portuguese fort sits atop the ancient Dilmun capital of Qal'at al-Bahrain, offering sweeping views and layers of history. Visit early morning or late afternoon to avoid the heat, and wear comfortable shoes for the sandy paths. It's about a 15-minute drive from central Manama; taxis are easy to find.

signature.name: Al Fateh Grand Mosque
signature.detail: One of the world's largest mosques, it welcomes non-Muslim visitors and boasts a stunning fiberglass dome and intricate Islamic calligraphy. Free guided tours run on weekday mornings; dress modestly (women should cover hair and arms, abayas provided). Located on King Faisal Highway, it's a short taxi ride from the souq.

transport: Taxis $5-10 for short trips; car rental $40-60 a day
